Vivian H: final draft uploaded. Need quick lane checks: headline, benchmark wording (no multipliers), legal-safe residency language, and HubSpot mapping for webinar signups. Link in doc. :hourglass:

Marco L: Headline option: 'Predictable inference for product teams' or "Ship inference you can rely on". Leaning to first.

Sana R: product nit: include one sentence in hero about rollout controls (pin model versions, canary rollback). Also add a two-line hosted vs dedicated compare box.

Vivian H: adding rollout sentence and the compare box.

Marco L: Benchmarks  use explicit numbers + test conditions: "median generation 235ms, p95 540ms at 1k tokens (NVIDIA A100, batch=8, FP16)". Add link to reproducibility notes.

Legal-Bot: Legal flag: remove absolutes like "we never see customer inputs". Replace with: "Customers may choose dedicated deployments or VPC peering to meet data residency and isolation requirements." Attach eval PDF to /legal/audit before publish.

Vivian H: updated residency phrasing per Legal-Bot. I'll upload the eval now.

Ops-Neil: Ops rec: publish Tue 09:00 PT, webinar Thu 11:00 PT (48h lead time). HubSpot form created at https://hubspot.forms/290123. Hidden fields: campaign=prod_launch_2901, source=blog. Add checkbox `wants_eval` to trigger eval delivery workflow.

Marco L: CTA: primary -> blog (inline form), secondary -> webinar. Checkbox copy: 'Send me the technical eval (PDF)'.

Vivian H: inbound mapping: list 'launch_2901', tags ['source:blog','interest:eval']; if wants_eval=true, workflow emails S3 link.

Legal-Bot: eval uploaded to /legal/audit/2901234567_eval.pdf. Legal sign-off on revised residency copy and CTO quote.

Marco L: product sign-off on benchmark phrasing and hero tweak.

Ops-Neil: Ops confirmed HubSpot mapping and workflow. Test form iframe posted.

Vivian H: thanks all. @publish-bot please schedule CMS publish for 2026-10-12T09:00:00-07:00 and wire webhook to the HubSpot form. Also schedule webinar for 2026-10-14T11:00:00-07:00.

publish-bot: Scheduled: Post 'Predictable inference for product teams' set to publish 2026-10-12 09:00 PDT. HubSpot webhook configured. Webinar scheduled for 2026-10-14 11:00 PDT.

Vivian H: final checklist complete: headline locked, benchmark box + eval attached, legal ok, HubSpot mapping live. Hitting publish on Tuesday unless objections. :rocket:
